name: Amazon Prime (incl. Prime Video)
notes: Researched from public Amazon Customer Service help pages only (no sign-in). Prime is charged automatically to an eligible payment method at the end of each membership period; there is no separate AutoPay, paper bill, guest pay or payment plan. Canceling refunds the full fee if no benefits were used in the paid period, otherwise a pro-rated refund of remaining full months (the engine does not model refunds). Monthly members who cancel can rejoin only after the paid month. Sign-in uses email or mobile number then password (two steps); Amazon 2-Step Verification is optional, so mfa stays none. Prime Access ($6.99/month for qualifying government-assistance recipients) is described in help but not modeled. There are no installment plans; payment_arrangement stays at the family default only because the streaming template always renders an installments form, and the setup-payment-plan task is suppressed. Integrated 2026-10-09: billing.methods ['card']: no saved checking account; generated tasks use the saved Visa.

guest_pay.note: The membership is charged to the payment method on your account; there is no bill to pay without signing in.

autopay.note: Amazon automatically charges your payment method for the next membership period when the current one ends; there is nothing separate to enroll in.

autopay_cancel.note: Recurring charges stop only when you cancel the subscription.

paperless.note: No paper bills are mailed; charges are shown on the account page and receipts are emailed.

payment_assistance.note: Prime Access: qualifying EBT, Medicaid, SNAP and other government-assistance recipients can pay $6.99 a month after verifying eligibility.

cancel_service.note: Cancel from Your Prime Membership. Unused paid periods are refunded in full; otherwise pro-rated by remaining full months. Prime billed through another company is canceled there.

help.title: The Amazon Prime membership fee
paragraphs: Amazon Prime costs $14.99 a month or $139 a year. A Prime Video-only membership is $8.99 a month. Prime for Young Adults is $7.49 a month or $69 a year.

Recipients of EBT, Medicaid, SNAP and some other government assistance can qualify for discounted Prime Access at $6.99 a month after verifying eligibility. Sales tax may apply in some states. When a trial or membership period ends, Amazon automatically charges for the next one.

help.title: Cancel your Prime membership
steps: Select Cancel Membership (or End trial and benefits during a free trial).
paragraphs: If you and your household have not used Prime benefits in the paid period, the full fee is refunded; otherwise the refund is pro-rated by the remaining full months. Refunds take three to five business days.

After canceling a monthly membership you can rejoin only after the month you already paid for. Channel subscriptions inside Prime Video, such as Paramount+, keep running after Prime ends. If another company bills your Prime, cancel with that company.

help.title: Prime refunds and support
paragraphs: To get extra help canceling, open the Customer Service page, choose Something else, then I need help with something else. Prime memberships started through Google Play on Android are canceled in Google subscription settings.
